#### Body

application/json

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-model)

model

string

required

Model name

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-prompt)

prompt

string

Text for the model to generate a response from

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-suffix)

suffix

string

Used for fill-in-the-middle models, text that appears after the user prompt and before the model response

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-images)

images

string\[\]

Base64-encoded images for models that support image input

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-format-one-of-0)

format

stringobjectstringobject

Structured output format for the model to generate a response from. Supports either the string `"json"` or a JSON schema object.

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-system)

system

string

System prompt for the model to generate a response from

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-stream)

stream

boolean

default:true

When true, returns a stream of partial responses

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-think-one-of-0)

think

booleanstringbooleanstring

Controls a model's thinking output. Use `/api/show` to discover the supported values and default for the selected model. `true` requests thinking, `false` requests no thinking output, and `null` uses the model default. String values are model-defined; supported names must match `/api/show` exactly. Numbers are not supported.

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-raw)

raw

boolean

When true, returns the raw response from the model without any prompt templating

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-keep-alive-one-of-0)

keep\_alive

stringnumberstringnumber

Model keep-alive duration (for example `5m` or `0` to unload immediately)

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-options)

options

object

Runtime options that control text generation

Show child attributes

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-logprobs)

logprobs

boolean

Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#body-top-logprobs)

top\_logprobs

integer

Number of most likely tokens to return at each token position when logprobs are enabled

#### Response

200

application/json

Generation responses

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-model)

model

string

Model name

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-created-at)

created\_at

string

ISO 8601 timestamp of response creation

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-response)

response

string

The model's generated text response

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-thinking)

thinking

string

The model's generated thinking output

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-done)

done

boolean

Indicates whether generation has finished

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-done-reason)

done\_reason

string

Reason the generation stopped

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-total-duration)

total\_duration

integer

Time spent generating the response in nanoseconds

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-load-duration)

load\_duration

integer

Time spent loading the model in nanoseconds

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-prompt-eval-count)

prompt\_eval\_count

integer

Number of input tokens in the prompt

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-prompt-eval-cached-count)

prompt\_eval\_cached\_count

integer

Number of prompt tokens read from the cache

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-prompt-eval-duration)

prompt\_eval\_duration

integer

Time spent evaluating uncached prompt tokens in nanoseconds

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-eval-count)

eval\_count

integer

Number of output tokens generated in the response

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-eval-duration)

eval\_duration

integer

Time spent generating tokens in nanoseconds

[​](https://docs.ollama.com/api/generate#response-logprobs)

logprobs

object\[\]

Log probability information for the generated tokens when logprobs are enabled
